name: 조약돌고기
colors: saturated deep cobalt blue fish skin, cool slate grey stone tops with bright pale blue highlights and dark navy crevices, ivory belly
shape: Rounded blue fish with SIX REAL THREE-DIMENSIONAL RIVER STONES EMBEDDED HALFWAY IN ITS FLANK SKIN. Each irregular slate stone has a raised domed top, light upper facets, dark lower facets, fine cracks and a dark recessed skin rim where the stone enters flesh. Exposed blue scales between stones. Stones are not painted spots, not crystals, not stacked on the back. Stubby rounded fins.

name: 물방울송사리
colors: vivid cyan blue back, bright turquoise swollen chin with pale mint highlights and deep teal shadows, dark blue thin fin rays
shape: Slender medaka fish with a VERY LARGE INFLATED LOWER JAW AND THROAT POUCH, like a bullfrog inflated throat integrated directly into the underside of the head. Continuous opaque scaly skin from the lower lip to the bulging throat, shaded rounded volume. The swollen chin is PART OF ITS ANATOMY, not a hanging water droplet, not a bubble, not a separate orb. Slim rear body and delicate forked tail.

name: 배후의 산천어
colors: saturated deep petrol teal body with luminous turquoise scale highlights, black shadowed back, vivid crimson oval rings and scarlet edged blade fins, tiny bright amber eye
shape: Monstrous spectacular predatory cherry trout boss. Heavy elongated scaly body, hooked snarling jaw with visible ivory fangs, fierce red eye, row of large black oval flank markings surrounded by vivid crimson rings. Huge jagged blade-like dorsal and pelvic fins swept backward, crimson fin edges and long forked spiked tail. Menacing asymmetric fin silhouette yet one ordinary fish head, no extra heads. Full body and all long fins safely within canvas with padding.
